title: Test handoff purge CLI behavior
description: Add CLI tests requiring exactly one purge selector and covering --id, --global, --task, and --all-scopes. Verify RFC3339 --before parsing, positive Go-duration --older-than parsing, mutual exclusion, rejection of age flags with --id, strict provider cutoff forwarding, human purge counts, {purged:N} JSON, zero matches, stray arguments, and provider failures.
